aura <version> — an AI-native Lisp

usage: aura <command> [args]     project commands
       aura demo                  watch a definition evolve in the terminal
       aura [options] file.aura   run one file (or stdin, or -e EXPR)

Commands:
  new    create a project (aura.toml, tests, CI, README)
  demo   watch a definition evolve in the terminal
  run    run the project entry with its aura.toml preset
  test   run tests/*.aura against tests/*.golden
  repl   interactive REPL with hot reload
  evo    inspect a project's evolution worldline
  lsp    language server on stdio (see docs/editor.md)
  soft   run a file with Restricted Mutate on its workspace
  help   show help for a command

Common options:
  -e, --eval EXPR    evaluate EXPR
  --preset dev|ci|prod, --grant CAPS, --deny CAPS   capabilities
  --fmt, --typecheck, --query Q, --inspect           tools
  -V, --version      print version

'aura help <command>' for details; 'aura help --all' for every option.
